author: jracer15
body: I have a small server, nothing public, mostly used for making maps, is there any good plugins that would be helpful?
body_tagged: I have a small server, nothing public, mostly used for making maps, is there any good plugins that would be helpful?
title: Some good plugins?

replies.author: awesome_apricot
replies.body: World Edit, Voxel, MultiVerse (very good), Essentials, PlayerHeads or TrophyHeads, EmptyWorldGenerator :D
replies.body_tagged: World Edit, Voxel, MultiVerse (very good), Essentials, PlayerHeads or TrophyHeads, EmptyWorldGenerator :D

replies.author: Porkyyy
replies.body:
If you're making a map, the most useful one is probably World Edit.
Make sure you know what they plugins do before using them.

replies.body: I already have world edit and playerheads, never have tried multiverse

replies.author: MLG_Jirafa
replies.body: World edit +  SporkPGM. That's what my team's server have

replies.author: KooDaLord
replies.body: Multiverse, world edit, voxelsniper, biome brush, essentials, some player head plugin and a cup of nudles pls.

replies.body: WorldEdit and SporkPGM. Never use Essentials or any shitty plugins like that

replies.body:
You need a multi-world plugin such as MultiWorld or Multiverse

replies.author: jracer15
replies.body: What would be an alternative for essentials?

replies.author: awesome_apricot
replies.body: MultiVerse allows you to have multiple maps or worlds open at one time on your server. You can just hop between them by using commands like /mv tp awesome_apricot *world name*
replies.body_tagged: MultiVerse allows you to have multiple maps or worlds open at one time on your server. You can just hop between them by using commands like /mv tp awesome_apricot *world name*

replies.author: Kels
replies.body: Nothing, use the vanilla minecraft commands. Most servers are perfect without essentials
